intro.title: Verify your identity
intro.idHint: Driver's license, state ID or passport
intro.selfieHint: To match you with your ID
intro.consent: I agree to the ID and selfie check.

type.title: Choose your ID
type.description: Issued in the US and not expired.

front.title: Front of your license
front.description: Lay it flat, all four corners in the frame.

frontId.title: Front of your ID card
frontId.description: Lay it flat, all four corners in the frame.

passport.title: Your passport's photo page
passport.description: Open it flat, the whole page in the frame.

back.title: Back of your license
back.description: Make sure the barcode is sharp.

backId.title: Back of your ID card
backId.description: Make sure the barcode is sharp.

check.title: Check your photo
check.description: Is the text readable, with no glare?
check.selfieDescription: Is your whole face in view?

alt.front: Your photo of the front of your ID
alt.back: Your photo of the back of your ID

check.dark: It looks dark. Try brighter light.
check.blurry: It looks blurry. Hold still and retake it.

selfie.title: Now a quick selfie
selfie.description: Face the camera in good light. Take off sunglasses and hats.
selfie.tip: We'll compare it with the photo on your ID.
selfie.cameraTitle: Fit your face in the oval

verifying.title: Verifying your ID
verifying.description: This usually takes under a minute.

result.verifiedBody: Your profile now shows ID verified.

blocked.too_many_attempts: Our team will take it from here

blocked.double_check_review: Our team is taking a look
